fact: The Ghana Card Number at Birth system, launched by the Vice President, integrates the Births and Deaths Registry, Ghana Health Service and National Identification Authority systems so a newborn's birth notification goes to the registry, which returns a birth registration number, and the child receives a unique ID number linked to the mother's identity.
Bedzrah said the system would facilitate deactivating the identity of deceased persons once their deaths are properly registered and verified.

NIA Executive Secretary Wisdom Kwaku Deku said the NIA is preparing to begin registration at hospitals, where parents or guardians would receive an identity number for newborns, to be linked to the child's Ghana Card registration at age six.

Vice President Bawumia launched the Ghana Card number at birth system on 14 March 2024, in which births notified from health facilities go to the Births and Deaths Registry, then to the National Identification Authority, which generates the baby's Ghana Card number and returns it.
